simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דָּקַק (H1854) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 13 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דָּקַק (dâqaq) means to crush (or intransitively) crumble First listed occurrence: 2Chr 15 16.

definitions.usage: beat in pieces (small), bruise, make dust, (into) × powder, (be, very) small, stamp (small).
definitions.full: H1854. daqaq [ דָּקַק ] verb crush, pulverise, thresh; be fine (Arabic be or become thin, minute ; Ethiopic Assyrian da‡â‡u Pa`el break in pieces COT Gloss ; Phoenician דק id. , Aramaic דַּקֵּק Pa`el id. , ) — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular דַּק Deut 9:21 , דָּ֑ק Exod 32:20 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יְדֻקֶּ֑נּוּ Isa 28:28 ; 2 masculine singular תָּדֹק 41:15 ; — 1 crush (transitive) followed by accusative לֶחֶם bread-stuff, corn Isa 28:28 ; of threshing || דּוּשׁ 41:15 (figurative of pulverizing mountains) 2 only Perfect; be fine , of state to which Moses reduced the golden calf by grinding אֲשֶׁרדָּֿק֑ עַד וַיִּטְחַן Exod 32:20 ; לְעָפָר אֲשֶׁרדַּֿק עַד הֵיטֵב טָחוֺן אֹתוֺ וָאֶכֹּת Deut 9:21 . Hiph`il Perfect הֵדַק 2Kin 23:15 ; 2Chr 34:4 ; 2 feminine singular וַהֲדִקּוֺתְ consecutive Micah 4:13 ; Imperfect וַיָּ֫דֶק 2Kin 23:6 ; 2Chr 15:16 ; 1 singular suffix אֲדִקֵּם 2Sam 22:43 (but אֲרִיקֵם || Psa 18:43 ); Infinitive absolute הָדֵק Exod 30:36 ; construct לְהֵדַק 2Chr 34:7 (form anomalous compare Ew § 238 d Ol § 258 b Be; read perhaps לְהָדֵק Ki; or לָדַק [see כַּדַּק Isa 40:15 ] compare Öttli); — make dust of, pulverize לְעָפָר וַיָּ֫דֶק 2Kin 23:6 (i.e. the Ashera), || 2Chr 34:4 , 7 ( לְהֵדַק כִּתַּת ); so of the bamah לְעָפָר הֵדַק 2Kin 23:15 ; of the מִפְלֶצֶת 2Chr 15:16 ; figurative Micah 4:13 (object רַבִּים עַמִּים ); Exod 30:36 (P) has הָדֵק מִמֶּנָּה וְשָׁחַקְתָּ֫ and thou shalt beat some of it fine (i.e. the incense); 2Sam 22:43 read אֲרִיקֵם (|| Psa 18:43 ) for אֲדִקֵּם . Hoph`al Imperfect יוּדָ֑ק Isa 28:28 be crushed , subject לֶחֶם bread corn (compare above Qal ); — on sense compare Che Di.
